description: This file defines the interface for IWebAudioPlayerTaskFactory, a factory class responsible for creating various WebAudioPlayer tasks such as play, pause, stop, set caps, eos, set volume, write buffer, and handle bus messages within the Rialto media server component.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerTaskFactory
classes.description: An abstract factory class that provides methods to create various WebAudioPlayer tasks for media control and configuration.

methods.name: createShutdown
methods.description: Creates a task to shut down the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createStop
methods.description: Creates a task to stop the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createPlay
methods.description: Creates a task to start playback on the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createPause
methods.description: Creates a task to pause playback on the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createSetCaps
methods.description: Creates a task to set the media format (caps) for the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createEos
methods.description: Creates a task to signal end-of-stream for the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createSetVolume
methods.description: Creates a task to set the volume of the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createWriteBuffer
methods.description: Creates a task to write audio buffer data to the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createHandleBusMessage
methods.description: Creates a task to handle bus messages related to the WebAudioPlayer.
